title: 🎉 bayestestR receives a SIPS Commendation
summary: The bayestestR R package has received a Commendation from the Society for the Improvement of Psychological Science (SIPS).
content: The bayestestR R package, part of the easystats collection, has received a Commendation from the Society for the Improvement of Psychological Science (SIPS), following its description in Makowski et al. (2019) published in the Journal of Open Source Software.

bayestestR provides tools to describe and report Bayesian models and posterior distributions in a way that is accessible and standardised — helping lower the barrier to Bayesian analysis for psychologists.
An early recognition that helped set the tone for the easystats project's later Mission Award.
